_meta.purpose: Sitemap <lastmod> and JSON-LD dateModified source for content/docs/reference/pre-built-policy-packs/ pages.
_meta.generator: scripts/fetch-policy-packs.js (self-stamping diff on each nightly run)
_meta.methodology: A pack's lastmod is the date its data/policy_pack_policies/<pack>.json last actually changed content (canonicalized diff), not merely the date the file was last committed for an unrelated reason. Seeded 2026-08-15 from the git history of the initial commit that introduced these files (PR #20274); no pack has been republished with different content since, so all seed dates are the introduction commit date. Updated automatically going forward whenever fetch-policy-packs.js detects a real content change.
